# Advisories against vendored crates (vendor/*) that were reviewed and
# accepted. scripts/supply-chain-watch.py fails on any OSV advisory for a
# vendored crate name that is not listed here. One id per line:
#
#   GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx  # review-by YYYY-MM-DD owner=<name>
#
# Record why it does not apply (or what mitigates it) in the MR that adds it.
# scripts/check-advisory-ignores.py fails when a review date passes.

# vendor/zstd is zstd 0.14.3 relabeled 0.13.4. The advisories filed against
# the zstd crate name do not apply to its code: 0391 is fixed in 0.14.3, and
# 0392/0393 were fixed in 0.8.0 and 0.4.10.
RUSTSEC-2026-0391  # review-by 2027-01-26 owner=sqe-maintainers
RUSTSEC-2026-0392  # review-by 2027-01-26 owner=sqe-maintainers
RUSTSEC-2026-0393  # review-by 2027-01-26 owner=sqe-maintainers
